faq: Does SellPostly work only with one social platform?
No. Share a storefront link across social profiles, groups, videos, messages, websites and search listings. Available previews and posting tools depend on the channel.
What is the difference between Personal Store and Affiliate Deals Shop?

A Personal Store sells your own catalog with direct ordering options. An Affiliate Deals Shop recommends products and sends buyers to external merchant checkout. Affiliate items do not use the Personal Store cart or escrow flow.
Do I need to connect my social media passwords?

No. SellPostly formats text and prepares sharing links without asking for your social account passwords. You review and publish through your own accounts. The extension reads a product page only when you request an import.
Can I replace an imported or representative photo?

Yes. Upload a photo you have permission to use or choose a representative alternative. Amazon-related Affiliate photos have specific safeguards. Other affiliate merchant images and all Personal Store images are preserved by default.
Where do buyers pay and what protection applies?

Affiliate purchases are paid on the partner merchant’s website under its terms. Personal Store payment methods vary by seller. Any escrow protection applies only to an eligible order using the displayed escrow flow, not to every purchase or external link.
